Transsexualism is not a 'mental disorder' in the 'mental illness/delusion' sense. A 'sex change' is biologically impossible in that, yes, as many a transphobe who thinks they have an understanding of the science will tell you, hard-wired genetics cannot be changed. A trans person will never have a typical body of their true gender, but they will be essentially intersexed and very close.

Even if transsexualism was a mental illness, that's surprisingly irrelevant to its treatment, and there is a reason why that treatment exists. Transition regret rates are <2%.
